metadata.description: Live-captured via bin/mock-capture against <internal-env>/26.2.0.0, org group 138883 (sdktest), the recapture epic's Workstream C. Body {"SmartGroupIds":[<real smart group id>],"DeploymentParameters":{}} against a real internal iOS app (id 66115) created via tools/internalapps-capture for the capture (deleted immediately after). EMPIRICAL FINDING: DeploymentParameters must be present as a non-null (even empty) object -- omitting it entirely crashes the server with an opaque 500 (errorCode 1000 'Internal Server Error') despite the field being declared omitempty client-side; this mirrors the same 'omitempty sub-object is not actually optional live' pattern already documented for msi's HowToInstall/DeploymentOptions. SEPARATE FINDING: the first (omitted-DeploymentParameters) attempt returned a 500 to the client, but the assignment was created server-side anyway -- a retry with the identical smart group then received a clean 400 'SmartGroup with Id : <id> is already assigned to the Application id : <id>', proving the mutation succeeded despite the client-visible 500 (consistent with the PushMode-int-vs-string client-deserialize-crash-after-real-success pattern documented elsewhere in this ledger for InternalApplicationEntityV1). This fixture captures the clean success path (fresh, previously-unassigned smart group id + non-null empty DeploymentParameters). 201, empty body, no anonymization needed (body is null).
